senses.gloss:
(I)--a son of ब्रह्मा; one of the first two created, the other सनत्कुमार; a सिद्ध who knows the माया of Hari.
1: भा. II. 7. ४३; IV. 8. 1; VI. १५. १२; वा. 9. १०६; २४. ७९.
A resident of Tapoloka;
2: Br. III. ३६. 6; IV. 2. २४, ३५ and २१४; वा. १०१. २६, ३७ and २१२; वा. २५. ९२.
teacher of निदाघ; im- parted to him the essence of true knowledge after partaking of meals with him; once again met निदाघ after १००० years; initiated him into the mysteries of अद्वैत and disappeared.
3: Vi. II. १५. 2-३४; १६ (whole).
(II)--heard the विष्णु पुराण from ब्रह्मा; communicated to Priyavrata. Vi. VI. 8. ४३.

(I)--a class of gods resident in Bhuvarloka
1: वा. १०१. ३०.
specially created by भृगु to put down the प्रमथ and other गणस् in the sacrifice of दक्ष. Followers of Indra;
2: भा. IV. 4. ३३; VI. 7. 2; १०. १७.
of चाक्षुष epoch.
3: M. 9. २४.
[page१-269+ २९]
(II)--gods of the Vaivasvata epoch, came to द्वारका with other gods to ask कृष्ण to go back to Vai- कुन्ठ्२अ. भा. VIII. १३. 4; XI. 6. 2.
